title: Queen's Chamber shaft points at Orion

tellings.quote: chamber don't point at Orion, but one of the shafts of the Queen Chamber does.

related.note: Both say which star targets the Great Pyramid's chamber shafts point at. This telling puts Sirius on the Queen's Chamber, where the story says a Queen's Chamber shaft points at Orion.

plain: One of the narrow shafts running out from the Queen's Chamber, one of the inner rooms of the Great Pyramid, is said to point at the constellation Orion. A researcher named Graham Hancock says so on the show, without naming a source, noting that the shafts of the other chamber "don't point at Orion, but one of the shafts of the Queen Chamber does." It supports his view that the pyramid was built to line up with the stars.
